advisory.summary: Private repository metadata remained accessible after access was revoked.
note: Chosen because it is the shape a status oracle cannot see. The revoked
collaborator receives HTTP 200 on BOTH builds -- the fix removes the
private repository from the payload, not the endpoint. Only a planted
marker distinguishes them, which is the entire argument for the oracle.
It also answers the 'green because gone' objection: the owner control
probe returns 200 on the patched build, so the endpoint is still there.

The marker owner is deliberately absent from the check's expectations: including them makes their response at the CHECK path the positive control, which defeats marker_probe. This fix empties that list for everyone, so that control would be vacuous and Veridor -- correctly -- reports the exclusion as unverifiable rather than as a pass.

checks.name: A revoked collaborator must not still read the private repository
